title: The ‘Kid’ Takes Over: David Ellison Becomes a Hollywood Colossus
summary: With Paramount and Warner Bros. under his control, Mr. Ellison will be “the Hollywood equivalent of Superman, Caesar and Midas combined.” But challenges remain.
